title: flow_step's defensive severance branch implements slice-2.3 behavior early and resets to the wrong node vs. its own comment
detail: Unreachable in 1.3 (no demolish, pipes never removed) so no functional impact now, but it pre-implements slice-2.3 severance and its reset contradicts the comment: `p.at_node = p.src` jumps to the ORIGINAL source (Spawn_Req.src, never updated mid-traversal), not 'the node it just left' (the non-`heading` endpoint of `p.edge`). A multi-hop packet would teleport back to origin.
recommended_fix: Drop the branch (unreachable in 1.3; severance is slice 2.3) or reset to the lost edge's departure node: the `p.edge` endpoint that isn't `p.heading`, not `p.src`.
